principles: Gate/checker modules own decisions; renderers only display structured results.
Prefer extending existing shared artifacts over adding a parallel status-only rule path.
Regression coverage must encode user-visible guidance, not just internal helper return values.
High-risk gate changes should be incremental and leave existing story lifecycle behavior intact.
drivers: Prevent status/next from becoming stale when DONE/reviewer gates evolve.
Reduce hardcoded label/phase branching in renderer code.
Keep the change small enough to finish safely inside one story.

options.name: A: Expand DoneCheckRow into shared GateCheckRow and reuse it from session/status
pros: Small migration path from current code
Keeps DONE precheck as first concrete oracle
cons: Does not fully merge xstate guard failure text and checklist rows in one step

options.name: B: Centralize all phase gate checks in machine/getGuardFailureReason and make status call only machine APIs
cons: machine currently returns strings, not structured rows
Harder to preserve existing DONE checklist detail

options.name: C: Only add more smoke tests around current renderer behavior
cons: Future status logic can still drift

chosen: A: Expand DoneCheckRow into shared GateCheckRow and reuse it from session/status
rationale: A gives the strongest near-term reduction in duplicate status knowledge while preserving the existing DONE checklist and reviewer routing architecture. It creates a structured contract that renderers can consume now, without rewriting the entire state machine.

preMortem.scenario: Renderer still matches labels after GateCheckRow exists
preMortem.trigger: computeNextStep needs special wording and reaches for row.label switch
preMortem.consequence: Hardcoded status drift returns under a new type name
preMortem.mitigation: Add smoke coverage that checks next-step wording comes from failed row hints rather than generic phase advice

preMortem.scenario: Artifact contract and status disagree on docs reviewer
preMortem.consequence: Status shows docs reviewer but artifact checks do not
preMortem.mitigation: Thread projectRoot into the artifact contract path so both callers share computeActiveReviewers fallback behavior

preMortem.scenario: DONE checklist grows but next step becomes too verbose
preMortem.consequence: User sees technically correct but unusable next step
preMortem.mitigation: Render compact failed labels plus per-row hints in pre-check section; next step should summarize and point to the section

preMortem.scenario: Changing row type breaks story_advance DONE output
preMortem.trigger: renderDoneChecklist expects old fields or icons only
preMortem.consequence: DONE gate still blocks but output becomes less readable
preMortem.mitigation: Keep status/detail/hint backward compatible and cover renderDoneChecklist through flow-stability smoke
